checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV speed change at fixed sample rate

impact_assessment.why: resample changes both playback speed and the declared sample rate, so there is no way to time-compress audio while keeping the output rate.
impact_assessment.benefits: speed changes duration by a factor using deterministic linear interpolation while keeping the original sample rate and stereo format.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: factor positive finite, output frame count rounds correctly, factor 1 byte-identical, interpolation deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, halving, doubling and interpolation, a CLI command with --factor, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add score velocity normalization

impact_assessment.why: accent cycles fixed velocities and humanize jitters them, but there is no way to rescale a score's dynamics to a chosen peak while keeping their ratios.
impact_assessment.benefits: velocity scales all sounding note velocities by one factor so the loudest reaches --peak, preserving rests, timing and timbre as editable source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: peak 0..1, maximum reaches target exactly, ratios preserved, rests untouched, silent scores identity, round-trip; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for scaling, ratios, rests and round-trip, a CLI command reusing --peak, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add MIDI file inspection

impact_assessment.why: MIDI can be exported and imported but there is no read-only way to inspect a file's format, tracks and recovered musical content.
impact_assessment.benefits: midi-info prints a deterministic summary of a MIDI file's header and the score recovered by the existing import path.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests pinning the full report for MIDI generated by the project's writer, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add chord insertion into scores

impact_assessment.why: harmonize spawns voices from existing notes and pedal adds one note, but there is no way to insert a named-quality chord at a chosen beat.
impact_assessment.benefits: chord appends a triad at a specified beat and duration from a root and quality, leaving existing notes untouched and producing canonical source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: root must parse, quality from a fixed set, at non-negative, beats positive, pitches in MIDI range, round-trip; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for each quality, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command with --pitch/--quality/--beats, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add soft-clip distortion for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: gain applies linear trim with a hard clamp and crush reduces resolution, but there is no smooth saturation effect to add warmth or glue.
impact_assessment.benefits: distort applies a deterministic soft-saturation curve with a drive control, staying bounded and byte-identical at drive 0.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: drive 0..1, drive 0 identity, all samples within range, monotonic curve, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, bounded saturation, monotonicity and determinism, a CLI command with --drive, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a cascaded band-pass filter for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: lowpass and highpass exist separately, but removing rumble and hiss together needs a composed two-stage filter.
impact_assessment.benefits: bandpass chains a one-pole high-pass and low-pass in one pass with deterministic state, preserving frame count and rate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: both coefficients 0..1, known edge combinations exact, output bounded, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for the edge coefficient combinations and determinism, a CLI command with --high-alpha/--low-alpha, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.
